value.signature: fn check_file (root : & Path , selected : & str , facts : & Path) -> Result < Verdict , Refusal >

review.body: { let path = root . join (facts) ; let bytes = fs :: read (path) . map_err (| error | Refusal :: EvidenceInvalid (format ! ("facts: {}" , error . kind ()))) ? ; evaluate (selected , & bytes) }
review.item_premise: This body handles public installation evidence and conditional outcomes; it records no private installation observation or claimed trust.
